[[Molten Boss Charm]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molten Boss Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the [[Molten Boss]] enemy. When you bought the plushie, 24 hours after the purchase you would be emailed a code, which allows you to get [[Molten Nametag]] nametag and [[Molten Boss Charm]]. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 7 inches tall, 6.25 inches wide and 4.3 inches deep, or 17.78 centimetres tall, 15.875 centimetres wide and 10.922 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Molten Boss Mini Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online''' *:This Molten Boss Plushie won't burn you! ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Molten Boss Mini Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $16.99. You could also buy the Mini Boss Bundle, which came with all five boss plushies, which had a cost of $76.45. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} MoltenBossPlushShowcase1.png MoltenBossPlushShowcase2.png MoltenBossPlushShowcase3.png MoltenBossPlushShowcase4.png MoltenBossPlushShowcase5.png }} {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
